placements.title: calibration settled by reference-plate verification, not mere assertion
placements.frame: What does verification against named reference plates establish about an instrument's operational readiness beyond the bare claim that it is calibrated?
placements.why: Both expressions carry the same thematic content — the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz verified against June reference plates — performing its settling as both a witness's unhedged collective-verification claim (src-1) and a keyed decision record (src-2). The theme is instrument calibration verified against reference standards, a subject future envelopes will keep feeding as instruments are recalibrated and new reference plates are introduced. The specific 88.4 MHz value and June plates are facts that support this theme, not themes themselves.
